note: Town of Raymond campground on a grassy point of the town reservoir at the south end of Hell's Creek Golf Course, beside a community park with a playground, walking trails and fishing; a floating obstacle-course water park runs on the reservoir in July and August. --Claude

WATERFRONT (stored lakefront - keep, with a caveat): the campground is one loop on a grassy point of the Raymond reservoir (well over 5 acres; DEM 963-965 m at pads and shore, no dam berm). The east-side sites (where rigs sit on the imagery) are ~100-150 m from the water behind the loop and the park. The spurs at the south-west end of the loop sit ~20-35 m from the high-water edge across open mown grass with a few scattered trees and only a gravel walking path between - meets the open-apron test as I read it. Site numbers are not published, so the caveat can only name 'the south-west end of the loop'. Reviewer's call whether the shoreline walking path counts as a used strip; if it does, lakeview.
PIN (49.45150,-112.64710): on the west side of the loop among the sites; no move.
